items.title: Iran's Balochistan border region sees growing unrest
items.excerpt: Violence is on the rise in Iran's border region with Afghanistan and Pakistan. The Iran war could shift the strategic balance for militant groups operating in the area.

items.title: Ukraine: Life near the front line in Sloviansk
items.excerpt: As Russian continues to attack Sloviansk in eastern Ukraine, thousands of residents refuse to leave or struggle to find a way out. For many, poverty, family ties and beloved pets make evacuation painfully difficult.
